fullPassage: Situational ethics is an ethical theory that takes into account the context of a situation or an act when judging whether it is ethical. Supporters of this theory willingly permit casting aside absolute moral standards. In the absence of a universal standard or law, what matters is the outcome or consequences; so, the end justifies the means. Possibly the following contrasting realities can help illustrate the application of situational ethics. In a pickup game of basketball played among friends, everyone is expected to call his or her own fouls or acknowledge knocking the ball out-of-bounds. Caring about one's friends and maybe getting to keep playing with the group leads to these actions. But, once an organized game is played with officials, most athletes will not admit to the same fouls or violations as the end goal of winning is more important than expressing concern for competitors. Situational ethics has been extended by many athletes and coaches to mean trying to get away with as many actions on the field or court as possible to abandon competitive advantages.

questions.passage: Situational ethics is an (A)[ethical / unethical] theory that takes into account the context of a situation or an act when judging whether it is ethical. Supporters of this theory (B)[willingly / reluctantly] permit casting aside absolute moral standards. In a pickup game of basketball played among friends, everyone is expected to call his or her own fouls or (C)[acknowledge / ignore] knocking the ball out-of-bounds. Possibly the following contrasting realities can help illustrate the application of situational ethics. In a pickup game of basketball played among friends, everyone is expected to call his or her own fouls or acknowledge knocking the ball out-of-bounds. Caring about one's friends and maybe getting to keep playing with the group leads to these actions.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 상황 윤리는 윤리적(ethical) 이론이다. 지지자들은 기꺼이(willingly) 절대 도덕 기준을 제쳐 놓는다. 친구들 간 경기에서는 공을 아웃시킨 것을 인정(acknowledge)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ethical–willingly–acknowledge: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② reluctantly는 willingly의 반의어
❌ ③ unethical은 ethical의 반의어
❌ ④ 전부 부적합

questions.passage: In the (A)[absence / presence] of a universal standard or law, what matters is the outcome or consequences. Possibly the following contrasting realities can help (B)[illustrate / demonstrate] the application of situational ethics. Situational ethics has been (C)[extended / restricted] by many athletes and coaches to mean trying to get away with as many actions on the field or court as possible.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 보편적 기준의 부재(absence) 상태에서. 상황 윤리의 적용을 설명(illustrate)할 수 있다. 많은 운동선수와 코치에 의해 확대(extended)되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ absence–illustrate–extend: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① restrict는 extend의 반의어
❌ ② presence는 absence의 반의어
❌ ④ presence와 restrict 부적합

questions.passage: Situational ethics is an ethical theory that takes into account the context of a situation or an act when judging whether it is ethical. Supporters of this theory willingly permit casting aside absolute moral standards. In the absence of a universal standard or law, what matters is the outcome or consequences; so, the end (A)[justifies / condemns] the means. But, once an organized game is played with officials, most athletes will not admit to the same fouls or (B)[violations / achievements] as the end goal of winning is more important. Situational ethics has been extended by many athletes and coaches to mean trying to get away with as many actions on the field or court as possible to (C)[gain / abandon] competitive advantages. questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 목적이 수단을 정당화(justifies)한다. 같은 파울이나 반칙(violations)을 인정하지 않는다. 경쟁 우위를 얻기(gain) 위해.
det.analysis:
✅ ② justifies–violations–gain: 모두 문맥 적합 (원문 abandon은 부적절어휘이므로 gain이 정답)
❌ ① abandon: 경쟁 우위를 '포기'는 문맥상 부적절
❌ ③ condemns와 achievements 부적합
❌ ④ condemns와 abandon 부적합
det.tip: the end justifies the means(목적이 수단을 정당화한다) — 상황 윤리의 핵심 원리

Situational ethics has been extended by many athletes and coaches to mean trying to get away with as many actions as possible to ④<u>abandon</u> competitive advantages.

det.korean: ④abandon(포기하다)→gain(얻다): 경쟁 우위를 '포기'하는 것이 아니라 '얻기' 위해 많은 행동을 하려 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ abandon → gain: 선수들이 경쟁 우위를 얻기 위해 가능한 많은 행동을 하려 한다
❌ ① absolute: 원문 그대로 — 절대적 도덕 기준
❌ ② acknowledge: 원문 그대로 — 인정하다
❌ ③ violations: 원문 그대로 — 반칙
det.tip: gain(얻다) ↔ abandon(포기하다). 문맥: 선수들은 경쟁 우위를 '얻으려고' 규칙을 어긴다
